f.title: Include a description of pharmacovigilance and, where needed, risk management in a parallel import application
f.statement: An application for authorisation to distribute a medicinal product by parallel import in Liechtenstein must contain, among other items, a description of the pharmacovigilance system and, where necessary, of the risk management.
f.topic: PV description in parallel import application
f.applicability: Applications to the Office of Public Health (Amt für Gesundheit) for distribution by parallel import

rows.actor: Applicant for a parallel import authorisation
rows.quote: n) eine Beschreibung des Pharmakovigilanz- und erforderlichenfalls des Risikomanagements.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote. The quote is item n); the lead-in 'Der Antrag auf Genehmigung für den Vertrieb im Parallelimport hat zu enthalten' (the application shall contain) was read in the text.
rows.quote_en: n) a description of the pharmacovigilance and, where necessary, of the risk management.

f.title: Wholesalers relying on a health-insurance-association parallel import authorisation: attach a PV and risk management description
f.statement: Wholesalers that refer to a parallel import authorisation obtained by the Liechtenstein Health Insurance Association (Art. 3(4)) must attach to their application, among other items, a description of the pharmacovigilance and, where necessary, of the risk management.
f.topic: PV description in parallel import application
f.applicability: Parallel import applications referring to an authorisation of the Liechtensteinischer Krankenkassenverband

rows.actor: Wholesaler referring to a parallel import authorisation under Art. 3(4)
rows.quote: f) eine Beschreibung des Pharmakovigilanz- und erforderlichenfalls des Risikomanagements.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote. The quote is item f); the lead-in 'Grosshändler, die auf eine Genehmigung nach Abs. 4 Bezug nehmen, haben dem Antrag beizufügen' (wholesalers ... shall attach to the application) was read in the text.
rows.quote_en: f) a description of the pharmacovigilance and, where necessary, of the risk management.

f.title: Professional users and dispensers: report suspected serious ADRs, misuse, abuse and quality defects to the Office of Public Health
f.statement: Persons who professionally use or dispense human medicinal products must report to the Office of Public Health (Amt für Gesundheit): suspected serious adverse reactions; frequently observed improper use; serious abuse; or quality defects.
f.clause: Art. 11(1) Reporting duty for persons who professionally use or dispense medicinal products
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Persons who professionally use or dispense human medicinal products (e.g. healthcare professionals, pharmacies)
rows.quote: Personen, die Humanarzneimittel gewerbsmässig anwenden oder abgeben, müssen dem Amt für Gesundheit melden: a) vermutete schwerwiegende Nebenwirkungen; b) häufig beobachteten unsachgemässen Gebrauch; c) schwerwiegenden Missbrauch; oder d) Qualitätsmängel.
rows.location: Art. 11(1) Reporting duty for persons who professionally use or dispense medicinal products
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Duty falls on professional users/dispensers rather than MAHs; kept because it covers pharmacies and other businesses and defines the national spontaneous-reporting channel.
rows.quote_en: Persons who professionally use or dispense human medicinal products must report to the Office of Public Health: a) suspected serious adverse reactions; b) frequently observed improper use; c) serious abuse; or d) quality defects.

f.title: Parallel importers: report domestic suspected serious ADRs, misuse/abuse and quality defects within 15 days
f.statement: The holder of an authorisation for distribution by parallel import must report to the Office of Public Health without delay, and at the latest within 15 days of becoming aware, the following events occurring in Liechtenstein: suspected serious adverse reactions; frequently observed improper use or serious abuse of human medicinal products; or quality defects.
f.clause: Art. 12(1) Reporting duty for holders of a parallel import authorisation
f.processes: Submission operations; Case processing & follow-up; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Holder of an authorisation for distribution by parallel import in Liechtenstein
rows.deadline: Without delay, at the latest within 15 days of becoming aware
rows.quote: Der Inhaber einer Genehmigung für den Vertrieb im Parallelimport muss dem Amt für Gesundheit unverzüglich, spätestens aber innerhalb von 15 Tagen nach Bekanntwerden, Meldung erstatten über folgende im Inland aufgetretene Vorkommnisse: a) vermutete schwerwiegende Nebenwirkungen; b) häufig beobachteten unsachgemässen Gebrauch oder schwerwiegenden Missbrauch von Humanarzneimitteln; oder c) Qualitätsmängel.
rows.location: Art. 12(1) Reporting duty for holders of a parallel import authorisation
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote. 'Tagen' unqualified: recorded as calendar days.
rows.quote_en: The holder of an authorisation for distribution by parallel import must report to the Office of Public Health without delay, but at the latest within 15 days of becoming aware, the following events that occurred in Liechtenstein: a) suspected serious adverse reactions; b) frequently observed improper use or serious abuse of human medicinal products; or c) quality defects.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Suspected serious ADRs, frequent improper use or serious abuse, and quality defects occurring in Liechtenstein

f.title: Parallel importers: document and keep received reports for five years and provide them on request
f.statement: The holder of a parallel import authorisation must document the original wording of each report received, keep it for five years and transmit it to the Office of Public Health without delay on request.
f.clause: Art. 12(3) Reporting duty for holders of a parallel import authorisation
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Holder of an authorisation for distribution by parallel import in Liechtenstein
rows.deadline: Retain 5 years; provide without delay on request
rows.quote: Der Inhaber einer Genehmigung für den Vertrieb im Parallelimport hat den Originalwortlaut der ihm erstatteten Mitteilung zu dokumentieren und fünf Jahre aufzubewahren sowie auf Ersuchen des Amtes für Gesundheit diesem unverzüglich zu übermitteln.
rows.location: Art. 12(3) Reporting duty for holders of a parallel import authorisation
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: The holder of an authorisation for distribution by parallel import must document the original wording of the communication made to it, keep it for five years and, at the request of the Office of Public Health, transmit it to the Office without delay.

f.title: Parallel importers: inform the marketing authorisation holder of each report within 15 days
f.statement: Within the same period (at the latest 15 days of becoming aware), the holder of a parallel import authorisation must also inform the marketing authorisation holder (Genehmigungsinhaber) about the report.
f.topic: Exchange of safety information with MAH
f.clause: Art. 12(3) Reporting duty for holders of a parallel import authorisation
f.processes: Partner & vendor oversight; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Holder of an authorisation for distribution by parallel import in Liechtenstein
rows.deadline: Within the period in Art. 12(1): at the latest 15 days after becoming aware
rows.quote: Weiters hat der Inhaber einer Genehmigung für den Vertrieb im Parallelimport innerhalb der genannten Frist den Genehmigungsinhaber über diese Meldung zu informieren.
rows.location: Art. 12(3) Reporting duty for holders of a parallel import authorisation
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote. 'innerhalb der genannten Frist' refers back to the 15-day period in Art. 12(1), whose clock starts at 'Bekanntwerden'.
rows.quote_en: Furthermore, the holder of an authorisation for distribution by parallel import must inform the authorisation holder about this report within the said period.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Reports made under Art. 12 by parallel importers, to be passed to the marketing authorisation holder

f.title: Holders under Art. 11a and 12 EWR-AMG: send reports additionally direct to EMA
f.statement: The reporting duties under Art. 13(1b) EWR-AMG and Art. 12 of this Ordinance apply to authorisation holders under Art. 11a and 12 EWR-AMG, with the proviso that the reports must additionally be sent directly to EMA.
f.clause: Art. 13 Reporting duty for authorisation holders under Art. 11a and 12 EWR-AMG
f.processes: Submission operations; Case processing & follow-up; E2B / transmission

rows.actor: Authorisation holder under Art. 11a or 12 EWR-AMG
rows.quote: Die Meldepflichten nach Art. 13 Abs. 1b EWR-AMG und nach Art. 12 dieser Verordnung finden auf Genehmigungsinhaber nach Art. 11a und 12 EWR-AMG mit der Massgabe Anwendung, dass die Meldungen zusätzlich direkt an die EMA zu richten sind.
rows.location: Art. 13 Reporting duty for authorisation holders under Art. 11a and 12 EWR-AMG
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote. The categories of holders under Art. 11a and 12 EWR-AMG are defined in the Act, not in this Ordinance.
rows.quote_en: The reporting duties under Art. 13(1b) EWR-AMG and under Art. 12 of this Ordinance apply to authorisation holders under Art. 11a and 12 EWR-AMG with the proviso that the reports are additionally to be addressed directly to the EMA.

f.title: Report imminent danger to life or serious health risk immediately by telephone, in addition to writing
f.statement: Where there is an immediate danger to life or a serious and considerable danger to health, an immediate telephone report to the Office of Public Health must be made in addition to the written report.
f.processes: Submission operations; Case processing & follow-up; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Persons and holders subject to the reporting duties of Art. 11-13
rows.quote: Falls eine unmittelbare Gefährdung von Leben oder ernstliche und erhebliche Gefährdung der Gesundheit droht, muss neben der schriftlichen Meldung eine sofortige Meldung an das Amt für Gesundheit telefonisch erfolgen.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: If there is a threat of immediate danger to life or a serious and considerable danger to health, an immediate report must be made to the Office of Public Health by telephone in addition to the written report.

f.title: Use the Swissmedic or Austrian BASG vigilance forms for national reports
f.statement: Reports under Articles 11 and 12 must be transmitted using the vigilance report forms provided by the Swiss Agency for Therapeutic Products (Swissmedic) or by the Austrian Federal Office for Safety in Health Care (BASG).
f.systems: Swissmedic vigilance form; BASG vigilance form
f.processes: Submission operations; Case processing & follow-up; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Persons and parallel import authorisation holders reporting under Art. 11 and 12
rows.quote: Meldungen nach Art. 11 und 12 sind unter Verwendung der durch das Schweizerische Heilmittelinstitut (Swissmedic) oder der durch das österreichische Bundesamt für Sicherheit im Gesundheitswesen zur Verfügung gestellten Formblätter für Vigilanzmeldungen zu übermitteln.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: Reports under Art. 11 and 12 are to be transmitted using the forms for vigilance reports provided by the Swiss Agency for Therapeutic Products (Swissmedic) or by the Austrian Federal Office for Safety in Health Care.

f.title: Send authorisation holder reports to EMA electronically per European Commission guidance
f.statement: Reports by authorisation holders to EMA must be transmitted electronically in accordance with the European Commission guideline.

rows.quote: Meldungen der Genehmigungsinhaber an die EMA sind gemäss dem Leitfaden der Europäischen Kommission elektronisch zu übermitteln.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: Reports of the authorisation holders to the EMA are to be transmitted electronically in accordance with the guideline of the European Commission.

f.title: Reports must meet recognised scientific principles and the Commission guideline
f.statement: Reports must comply with generally recognised scientific principles and the requirements of the European Commission guideline.
f.processes: ICSR quality control; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Persons and holders reporting under this Ordinance
rows.quote: Die Meldungen haben den allgemein anerkannten wissenschaftlichen Grundsätzen und Anforderungen des Leitfadens der Europäischen Kommission zu entsprechen.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: The reports must comply with the generally recognised scientific principles and the requirements of the guideline of the European Commission.

f.title: Medical sales representatives: pass on adverse reaction information to the company scientific service
f.statement: Medical sales representatives must provide the scientific service referred to in Art. 98(1) of Directive 2001/83/EC with all information on the use of the medicinal products they promote, in particular the adverse reactions reported to them by the persons they visit.

rows.actor: Medical sales representatives (and their employer, the company)
rows.quote: Die Arzneimittelvertreter müssen der in Art. 98 Abs. 1 der Richtlinie 2001/83/EG genannten wissenschaftlichen Stelle alle Angaben über die Verwendung der Arzneimittel, für die sie Werbung treiben, vorlegen, insbesondere mit Bezug auf die unerwünschten Nebenwirkungen, die ihnen von den besuchten Personen mitgeteilt werden.
data_elements: adverse reaction reported to sales representative
rows.review_note: Review: checked against the consolidated text (version 06.05.2015); quote proves the statement. Bilingual check: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en; German 'muss', 'hat ... zu', 'sind ... zu' = shall (Mandatory). Double-check: statement adds nothing beyond the quote.
rows.quote_en: Medical sales representatives must submit to the scientific service referred to in Art. 98(1) of Directive 2001/83/EC all information on the use of the medicinal products they promote, in particular with regard to the adverse reactions communicated to them by the persons visited.

dates.title: Liechtenstein EWR-Arzneimittelverordnung (EWR-AMV): enters into force
dates.scope: Parallel importers, persons who professionally use or dispense medicinal products, authorisation holders and medical sales representatives in Liechtenstein
dates.quote: Diese Verordnung tritt am Tage der Kundmachung in Kraft.
dates.quote_en: This Ordinance enters into force on the day of its promulgation.
dates.timing_note: Promulgated (ausgegeben) 2011-09-13 + 0 days = 2011-09-13. The captured text is the consolidated version of 06.05.2015 (Art. 19 amended by LGBl. 2015 Nr. 134; no PV provision changed).
